bluf: Propellernet is a UK digital PR, SEO and AI search agency founded in 2004 that sells being found in search, AI answers and the media, with a proprietary AI visibility tracker, Ebb, and AI training for client teams. The record shows it named Integrated & SEO Agency of the Year 2025 and PR Agency of the Year 2026, and practising 3 of 3 tested lines on its own house, llms.txt included. Horus reads Favored at 26.8; Monsoon reads Breeze at 53.3. What a rival should know: 15 of 20 listed clients carry an observed need, and the openings that exist are pricing, assistant ads and the ATL media line.
doing:
The positioning line, search experts, storytellers and strategists getting brands found in search, AI answers and the media through connected digital PR, SEO, content and paid media, decodes as a digital PR house that has made AI answers a third surface beside search and press. The headline claim is two awards, Integrated & SEO Agency of the Year 2025 and PR Agency of the Year 2026, from the homepage meta, awarding body not named.

Three lead lines score 3. AI Search / GEO: the H1 promises LLM recommendations, the proprietary Ebb tracker measures AI visibility, with AI Overview wins for Remitly and PureGym. Content & Digital PR: the title leads with Digital PR and there are ten international digital PR market pages. SEO: the SEO & AI Search page covers audits, migrations, schema and international work. Four core lines score 2: AI Automation / Agents, on AI training and Agentic AI offers and a five session AI upskilling programme for 512 Bauer Media staff; Data & Measurement, on an Analytics page (GA4 audits, tag management, attribution, dashboards) and an English Heritage GTM case; Paid Search, on a Dogs Trust search ROI case and Performance Max cases for Kuoni, CV Villas and Woburn; Programmatic & CTV, on an ATL Media page spanning TV, CTV, VOD, OOH and audio, with AdSmart cases for Inghams. CRO and Paid Social score 1; the rest score 0. Breadth is 9. Proprietary: Ebb, AnswerThePublic, CoverageBook, Hidden Keywords, Search Listening and Propellernet Labs; no partners.

Its AI posture is product plus training: Ebb and GEO consultancy, and AI training, agentic AI and upskilling for client teams; the Horus read scores P1, P2, P4 and P6 as making.

Dated moves: the awards, 2025 and 2026; the Ebb launch is undated.

The record lists no pricing model and no office. Conspicuously absent: any creator line, any owned audience or CRM work, and any of its own ads on LinkedIn.
clients:
The client type is mixed; verticals listed are travel, ecommerce, charity and non profit, finance and insurance, health and beauty, and automotive; the home market is the UK, with no office listed.

The record lists 20 clients, 9 with case studies and 11 with slugs, and 15 carry an observed need. Organic demand, N1: Remitly (owning immigration search and AIO visibility, also N9), CV Villas (swimmable seas ranking), Compare and Recycle (real time search moments), Holland & Barrett (tech SEO), Autotrader (PR and SEO, also N12) and iCandy (tripling organic traffic). AI and automation, N9: Bauer Media (building AI confidence), PureGym (winning the AI Overview race) and MoneySuperMarket (Carin, a client voice AI bot). Paid performance, N2: Kuoni (Performance Max), Dr Barbara Sturm (paid media) and Evans Cycles (Heartwork, also N3). PR, N12: SportsShoes (coverage across five European markets). Brand, N3: Panasonic (its Olympic partnership). Data, N5: English Heritage (GTM consultancy). The computed mix puts N1 at 0.378, N9 at 0.237 and N2 at 0.156.

The 5 names only are Dogs Trust, Inghams Walking, Scrap Car Comparison, Sky and Beauty Pie, though the Dogs Trust slug names donation ROI; their need is inferred from the lines it leads with.

One client is shared: MoneySuperMarket also sits on the neomam-studios book.

What the base needs next: best placed for KJ1, the click is being replaced by the citation, driven by AI Search / GEO and Content & Digital PR, and for KJ6, the agency middle is being hollowed out, driven by AI Automation / Agents, a tailwind. It is very likely, with moderate confidence, that its travel, finance and ecommerce clients will buy AI visibility measurement and AI training next, and likely, with low confidence, that they shop elsewhere for paid social and ATL, where KJ5 exposure sits.
house: Say and do: 3 of 3 tested lines are practised, house integrity 100, and the Radar flags no gaps. AI Search / GEO is corroborated: it publishes an llms.txt, which says it built AnswerThePublic and CoverageBook, and carries 20 AI topic URLs in its sitemap; Paid Search is corroborated, with its own Google ads, 2 in the Transparency Center and 1 in the last 30 days; Publishing cadence is corroborated, 57 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days and 221 in 365. No AI crawlers are blocked. The site runs on WordPress with gtm as the only tag, no social pixels, no test tools and no ABM stack. Content velocity: 598 sitemap URLs, 57 in 90 days, 221 in 365. Google ads: 2, both text, last shown 2026-09-27, with two advertisers on the domain record, Propellernet Ltd and PIRUZA SHAHINYAN, and no sample text captured. LinkedIn shows 0 ads. Channels linked: LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.
market:
The Horus read puts Propellernet at a tailwind index of 26.8, Favored band, percentile 85, best fit The Toll Road at 47/100. Best placed for KJ1, the click is being replaced by the citation, net 0.368, driven by AI Search / GEO, and for KJ6, the agency middle is being hollowed out, net 0.231, driven by AI Automation / Agents. Most exposed to KJ5, the price of attention splits in two, net negative 0.107, driven by Programmatic & CTV and Paid Social. P moves: making P1, P2, P4 and P6 (AI upskilling as a talent pipeline); absent on P7 and P8 (no sign of testing ads inside assistants); P5 unknown; P3 not applicable.

The Monsoon read is 53.3, Breeze band, percentile 40, migration 51.8 against displacement 54.8, inferred; no hub office or onshore claim is listed. 52 of it is the sold mix, SEO (14) and Content & Digital PR (9) carrying the most movable hours; the work would go 65% to South and Southeast Asia, 20% to Eastern Europe and 15% to Africa and the Maghreb.
openings:
The openings are few: the record computes three, and none is a contradiction. The strongest is P8: it sells paid search and shows no sign of testing ads inside AI assistants, so it is likely, with moderate confidence, that the first rival in its segment to publish holdout results for assistant ads sets the price with its travel and finance clients. The falsifier is a Propellernet case or Ebb release covering assistant ads before the next compile.

The second is P5: no public pricing model, so an outcome priced AI visibility offer meets a conversation it cannot have in public.

The third is KJ5 exposure on the ATL and paid social lines, Programmatic & CTV and Paid Social, where the sold mix leans on hours the judgment removes; the addressable TV and AdSmart work for Inghams is the account a rival with a walled garden price story approaches first, with low confidence.

Contestable clients are scarce: MoneySuperMarket already sits on the neomam-studios book, and the 5 names only accounts are where a rival asks what was delivered. On price, displacement 54.8 makes an offshore undercut on SEO and PR hours roughly even chance to land.
watch: I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, next reading late October 2026: growth below 10% flags cannibalization of the SEO click, and above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and rewards Ebb and the AI search lines.
I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, next reading late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk behind KJ1.

I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, next reading October 2026: outcome pricing at a top five holdco would test whether its KJ6 tailwind holds against a priced rival, with P5 unknown.
I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, next reading rolling: the next milestone ($2B) and pricing below $20 CPM would make its absent P8 assistant ad test a cost on KJ2 ground.
Follow up the undated Ebb launch and the 2026 PR Agency of the Year award for the awarding body and any published Ebb pricing, which would close the P5 opening.
The next Radar compile refreshes offices, ads, sitemap cadence and clients; this dossier is only as fresh as the 2026-09-28 compile.
